description: East Hills Stormwater Catchment Flood Study is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Canterbury-Bankstown Council. Study Area The study area is located within the Sydney suburb of East Hills. The study area is a small urban catchment centred on the East Hills Railway station, which drains through a stormwater pipe network to the Georges River. Coverage: Canterbury-Bankstown Council.
